settings.intro: An exploratory fly fishing journey across Socotra’s beaches and reefs.

settings.heading: Explore the fishing.
settings.intro: Explore Socotra’s Indian Ocean shores with a fly rod, from trevally and bonefish to permit, triggerfish and reef species.

settings.heading: A fly fishing frontier
settings.text: The original expedition describes a pioneering trip with varied shore and boat opportunities.

settings.heading: Many ways to fish
settings.text: Trevally, bonefish, permit, triggerfish, snapper and other reef fish appear in the legacy species list.

settings.heading: Limited windows
settings.text: The legacy guide names October, March and April as fly fishing windows. Confirm current departures with the team.

settings.heading: Plan your next trip.
settings.text: Tell us your preferred window. Our team will confirm current departures and arrangements.
